sedan.author: Comrade1280 (https://sketchfab.com/comrade1280)
sedan.title: Generic passenger car pack
sedan.adaptations: Selected independent body and nearest four wheel assemblies; unrelated pack wheels removed. Dequantized before world-space baking; normalized to metres, -Z forward, Y=0 ground. Rigged independent steering pivots and spinning wheel children. Retained source maps, tuned PBR and authored normal/roughness paint detail; separated light roles and side indicators; baked indexed geometry and distinct distance LODs.

player.title: Porsche 911 GT3
player.adaptations: Original model decoded, uniformly normalized and indexed; original detailed cockpit and independent wheel/caliper, steering, wiper and mirror rigs exported in canonical metre units. Cyan physical paint, tuned lamps, driver-eye metadata and original mirror UVs retained.

runtimeCorrections: Corrected the generic pack to -Z forward; separated shared coupe head/reverse optics; fitted supplemental signals by raycasting the actual body skin; kept source police wheel dimensions independent of measured exports; cut police/truck window apertures and truck wheel arches; cleared steps/ribs and mounted rear truck lamps. Canonical pivots bind as Object3D nodes returned by GLTFLoader.
